speaker: QuEra Computing (press release)
verbatim: 2026: Introduction of a third-generation quantum error-corrected model with 100 logical qubits and over 10,000 physical qubits.
headline: QuEra will introduce a quantum computer with 100 logical qubits and over 10,000 physical qubits in 2026.
resolution_criteria: Resolves VERIFIED if, by 31 Dec 2026 (plus grace), QuEra has introduced a system (available to customers or publicly operated) with at least 100 error-corrected logical qubits and more than 10,000 physical qubits, confirmed by a QuEra announcement plus independent reporting or a paper. PARTIALLY_VERIFIED if only one of the two figures is met, or both are met only in a one-off research demonstration rather than an introduced system. NOT_VERIFIED otherwise.
